Do we have that Nat.gcd distributes over Nat.lcm, and other DistribLattice lemmas like it?

import Mathlib

def dvdLattice : DistribLattice Nat where
  le a b := a ∣ b
  lt a b := a ∣ b ∧ ¬b ∣ a
  lt_iff_le_not_ge _ _ := .rfl
  le_refl := Nat.dvd_refl
  le_antisymm _ _ := Nat.dvd_antisymm
  le_trans _ _ _ := Nat.dvd_trans
  sup := Nat.lcm
  le_sup_left := Nat.dvd_lcm_left
  le_sup_right := Nat.dvd_lcm_right
  sup_le _ _ _ := Nat.lcm_dvd
  inf := Nat.gcd
  inf_le_left := Nat.gcd_dvd_left
  inf_le_right := Nat.gcd_dvd_right
  le_inf _ _ _ := Nat.dvd_gcd
  le_sup_inf a b c := by
    unfold_projs
    refine ⟨1, Eq.trans ?_ (Nat.mul_one _).symm⟩
    obtain rfl | ha := eq_or_ne a 0
    · simp
    obtain rfl | hb := eq_or_ne b 0
    · simp
    obtain rfl | hc := eq_or_ne c 0
    · simp
    apply Nat.factorization_inj (by simp [ha, hb, hc]) (by simp [ha, hb, hc])
    ext
    simp [Nat.factorization_gcd, Nat.factorization_lcm, ha, hb, hc, sup_inf_left]

variable (a b c : Nat)

theorem Nat.lcm_gcd_left :
    Nat.lcm a (Nat.gcd b c) = Nat.gcd (Nat.lcm a b) (Nat.lcm a c) :=
  @sup_inf_left Nat dvdLattice a b c

theorem Nat.lcm_gcd_right :
    Nat.lcm (Nat.gcd a b) c = Nat.gcd (Nat.lcm a c) (Nat.lcm b c) :=
  @sup_inf_right Nat dvdLattice a b c

theorem Nat.gcd_lcm_left :
    Nat.gcd a (Nat.lcm b c) = Nat.lcm (Nat.gcd a b) (Nat.gcd a c) :=
  @inf_sup_left Nat dvdLattice a b c

theorem Nat.gcd_lcm_right :
    Nat.gcd (Nat.lcm a b) c = Nat.lcm (Nat.gcd a c) (Nat.gcd b c) :=
  @inf_sup_right Nat dvdLattice a b c

import Mathlib

variable (a b c : Nat)

theorem Nat.gcd_dvd_lcm : Nat.gcd a b ∣ Nat.lcm a b :=
  Nat.dvd_trans (Nat.gcd_dvd_left a b) (Nat.dvd_lcm_left a b)

theorem Nat.gcd_lcm_left :
    Nat.gcd a (Nat.lcm b c) = Nat.lcm (Nat.gcd a b) (Nat.gcd a c) := by
  obtain rfl | ha := eq_or_ne a 0
  · simp
  obtain rfl | hb := eq_or_ne b 0
  · simp [Nat.lcm_eq_left (Nat.gcd_dvd_left a c)]
  obtain rfl | hc := eq_or_ne c 0
  · simp [Nat.lcm_eq_right (Nat.gcd_dvd_left a b)]
  have habc : 0 < Nat.gcd (Nat.gcd a b) (Nat.gcd a c) := by positivity
  apply Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left habc
  rw [Nat.gcd_mul_lcm, Nat.gcd_assoc, Nat.gcd_left_comm, Nat.gcd_gcd_self_right_left,
    Nat.gcd_left_comm, ← Nat.gcd_mul_left, ← Nat.gcd_mul_right a (Nat.lcm b c) (Nat.gcd b c),
    Nat.gcd_mul_lcm, ← Nat.gcd_assoc, Nat.mul_comm, Nat.gcd_mul_left, Nat.gcd_assoc,
    Nat.gcd_eq_left (Nat.gcd_dvd_lcm b c)]
  simp_rw [← Nat.gcd_mul_left, ← Nat.gcd_mul_right, Nat.mul_comm b a]
  ac_rfl

theorem Nat.gcd_lcm_right :
    Nat.gcd (Nat.lcm a b) c = Nat.lcm (Nat.gcd a c) (Nat.gcd b c) := by
  rw [Nat.gcd_comm, Nat.gcd_lcm_left, Nat.gcd_comm c, Nat.gcd_comm c]

theorem Nat.lcm_gcd_left :
    Nat.lcm a (Nat.gcd b c) = Nat.gcd (Nat.lcm a b) (Nat.lcm a c) :=
  calc
    Nat.lcm a (Nat.gcd b c) = Nat.lcm (Nat.lcm a (Nat.gcd a c)) (Nat.gcd b c) := by
      rw [Nat.lcm_eq_left (Nat.gcd_dvd_left a c)]
    _ = Nat.lcm a (Nat.gcd (Nat.lcm a b) c) := by
      simp only [Nat.lcm_assoc, Nat.gcd_lcm_right]
    _ = Nat.lcm (Nat.gcd a (Nat.lcm a b)) (Nat.gcd (Nat.lcm a b) c) := by
      rw [Nat.gcd_eq_left (Nat.dvd_lcm_left a b)]
    _ = Nat.lcm (Nat.gcd (Nat.lcm a b) a) (Nat.gcd (Nat.lcm a b) c) := by
      rw [Nat.gcd_comm]
    _ = Nat.gcd (Nat.lcm a b) (Nat.lcm a c) := by
      rw [Nat.gcd_lcm_left]

theorem Nat.lcm_gcd_right :
    Nat.lcm (Nat.gcd a b) c = Nat.gcd (Nat.lcm a c) (Nat.lcm b c) := by
  rw [Nat.lcm_comm, Nat.lcm_gcd_left, Nat.lcm_comm c, Nat.lcm_comm c]

import Mathlib.Order.ModularLattice
import Mathlib.Tactic.Order

variable {α : Type*} [Lattice α]

theorem isModularLattice_iff_eq_of_le_of_inf_le_of_le_sup :
    IsModularLattice α ↔ ∀ x y z : α, x ≤ y → y ⊓ z ≤ x → y ≤ x ⊔ z → x = y :=
  ⟨@eq_of_le_of_inf_le_of_le_sup α _, fun h => {
    sup_inf_le_assoc_of_le {x} y {z} hxz := ge_of_eq (h _ _ y (by order) (by order) (by order))
  }⟩

abbrev DistribLattice.ofInfInfLeSupSup
    (inf_inf_le_sup_sup : ∀ a b c : α,
      (a ⊔ b) ⊓ (a ⊔ c) ⊓ (b ⊔ c) ≤ (a ⊓ b) ⊔ (a ⊓ c) ⊔ (b ⊓ c)) :
    DistribLattice α where
  le_sup_inf x y z := by
    apply ge_of_eq
    wlog _ : x ≤ z generalizing x y z with ih <;>
      suffices _ : x ⊔ (x ⊔ y) ⊓ (x ⊔ z) ⊓ (y ⊔ z) = (x ⊔ y) ⊓ (x ⊔ z) by
        specialize inf_inf_le_sup_sup x y z
        order
    · rw [← inf_comm (y ⊔ z), ih x (y ⊔ z) _ (by order)]
      order
    · order

abbrev DistribLattice.ofEqOfInfSupEq
    (eq_of_inf_eq_sup_eq : ∀ a b c : α, b ⊓ a = c ⊓ a → b ⊔ a = c ⊔ a → b = c) :
    DistribLattice α :=
  .ofInfInfLeSupSup fun a b c => by
    have mod : IsModularLattice α :=
      isModularLattice_iff_eq_of_le_of_inf_le_of_le_sup.2 fun x y z _ _ _ =>
        eq_of_inf_eq_sup_eq z x y (by order) (by order)
    let u := a ⊓ (b ⊔ c) ⊔ (b ⊓ c)
    let v := b ⊓ (a ⊔ c) ⊔ (a ⊓ c)
    let w := c ⊓ (a ⊔ b) ⊔ (a ⊓ b)
    let eu := (a ⊔ b) ⊓ (a ⊔ c) ⊓ (b ⊔ c)
    let ed := (a ⊓ b) ⊔ (a ⊓ c) ⊔ (b ⊓ c)
    have hcc (i j k : α) : i ⊓ (j ⊔ k) ⊔ (j ⊓ k) = (i ⊔ (j ⊓ k)) ⊓ (j ⊔ k) := by
      rw [← inf_comm (j ⊔ k), inf_sup_assoc_of_le _ (by order), inf_comm (j ⊔ k)]
    show eu ≤ ed
    have hiuv : u ⊓ v = ed := by
      unfold u v ed
      clear *-mod
      rw [← inf_sup_assoc_of_le _ (by order), ← sup_comm (b ⊓ c),
        sup_inf_assoc_of_le _ (by order)]
      order
    have hiuw : u ⊓ w = ed := by
      unfold u w ed
      clear *-mod
      rw [← inf_sup_assoc_of_le _ (by order), ← sup_comm (b ⊓ c),
        sup_inf_assoc_of_le _ (by order)]
      order
    have hivw : v ⊓ w = ed := by
      unfold v w ed
      clear *-mod
      rw [← inf_sup_assoc_of_le _ (by order), ← sup_comm (a ⊓ c),
        sup_inf_assoc_of_le _ (by order)]
      order
    have hsuv : u ⊔ v = eu := by
      unfold u v eu
      clear *-mod hcc
      rw [hcc a b c, hcc b a c]
      rw [← sup_inf_assoc_of_le _ (by order), ← inf_comm (b ⊔ c),
        inf_sup_assoc_of_le _ (by order)]
      order
    have hsuw : u ⊔ w = eu := by
      unfold u w eu
      clear *-mod hcc
      rw [hcc a b c, hcc c a b]
      rw [← sup_inf_assoc_of_le _ (by order), ← inf_comm (b ⊔ c),
        inf_sup_assoc_of_le _ (by order)]
      order
    have hsvw : v ⊔ w = eu := by
      unfold v w eu
      clear *-mod hcc
      rw [hcc b a c, hcc c a b]
      rw [← sup_inf_assoc_of_le _ (by order), ← inf_comm (a ⊔ c),
        inf_sup_assoc_of_le _ (by order)]
      order
    have huv : u = v := eq_of_inf_eq_sup_eq w u v (hiuw.trans hivw.symm) (hsuw.trans hsvw.symm)
    order

import Mathlib.Order.Lattice
import Mathlib.Tactic
namespace DistribLattice
variable (α : Type*) [Lattice α]
section OfCancellation
variable {α}
variable (h : ∀ x y z : α, x ⊔ y = x ⊔ z → x ⊓ y = x ⊓ z → y = z)
include h
/-
Core consequence of cancellation: if `p ⊓ q ≤ t ≤ q`, then `t = q ⊓ (p ⊔ t)`.
-/
private lemma cancel_key (p q t : α) (h1 : p ⊓ q ≤ t) (h2 : t ≤ q) :
    t = q ⊓ (p ⊔ t) := by
      contrapose! h;
      refine' ⟨ p, t, q ⊓ ( p ⊔ t ), _, _, h ⟩;
      · refine' le_antisymm _ _;
        · exact sup_le_sup_left ( le_inf h2 ( le_sup_right ) ) _;
        · aesop;
      · refine' le_antisymm _ _ <;> simp_all +decide [ ← inf_assoc ];
        exact le_trans ( inf_le_right ) h2
/-
The lattice is modular: for `a ≤ c`, `a ⊔ (b ⊓ c) = (a ⊔ b) ⊓ c`.
-/
private lemma cancel_modular (a b c : α) (hac : a ≤ c) :
    a ⊔ (b ⊓ c) = (a ⊔ b) ⊓ c := by
      convert cancel_key _ b c ( a ⊔ ( b ⊓ c ) ) _ _ using 1;
      · simp +decide [ inf_comm, sup_left_comm ];
      · assumption;
      · exact le_sup_right;
      · exact sup_le hac ( inf_le_right )
/-
The two representations of the "median" building block agree (from modularity).
-/
private lemma cancel_repr (a b c : α) :
    (a ⊓ (b ⊔ c)) ⊔ (b ⊓ c) = (a ⊔ (b ⊓ c)) ⊓ (b ⊔ c) := by
      convert cancel_modular h ( b ⊓ c ) a ( b ⊔ c ) _ using 1;
      · exact sup_comm _ _;
      · rw [ sup_comm ];
      · exact le_trans inf_le_left le_sup_left
/-
`u ⊔ v = M` where `M = (a⊔b) ⊓ (a⊔c) ⊓ (b⊔c)`.
-/
private lemma cancel_sup_fact (a b c : α) :
    ((a ⊓ (b ⊔ c)) ⊔ (b ⊓ c)) ⊔ ((b ⊓ (a ⊔ c)) ⊔ (a ⊓ c))
      = (a ⊔ b) ⊓ (a ⊔ c) ⊓ (b ⊔ c) := by
        have h_sup_inf : (a ⊓ (b ⊔ c)) ⊔ (b ⊓ (a ⊔ c)) = ((a ⊓ (b ⊔ c)) ⊔ b) ⊓ (a ⊔ c) := by
          convert cancel_modular h ( a ⊓ ( b ⊔ c ) ) b ( a ⊔ c ) _ using 1;
          exact le_sup_of_le_left inf_le_left;
        have h_sup_inf2 : (a ⊓ (b ⊔ c)) ⊔ b = (a ⊔ b) ⊓ (b ⊔ c) := by
          convert cancel_modular h b a ( b ⊔ c ) _ using 1;
          · exact sup_comm _ _;
          · rw [ sup_comm ];
          · exact le_sup_left;
        convert h_sup_inf using 1;
        · simp +decide [ sup_assoc, sup_comm, sup_left_comm ];
          exact le_sup_of_le_left ( inf_le_inf_left _ ( le_sup_right ) );
        · grind
/-
`u ⊓ v = m` where `m = (a⊓b) ⊔ (a⊓c) ⊔ (b⊓c)`.
-/
private lemma cancel_inf_fact (a b c : α) :
    ((a ⊓ (b ⊔ c)) ⊔ (b ⊓ c)) ⊓ ((b ⊓ (a ⊔ c)) ⊔ (a ⊓ c))
      = (a ⊓ b) ⊔ (a ⊓ c) ⊔ (b ⊓ c) := by
        -- Apply the cancellation law to the rewritten terms.
        have h_sup_inf2 : (a ⊔ (b ⊓ c)) ⊓ (b ⊔ (a ⊓ c)) = ((a ⊔ (b ⊓ c)) ⊓ b) ⊔ (a ⊓ c) := by
          apply le_antisymm;
          · have h_modular : a ⊔ b ⊓ c ≥ a ⊓ c := by
              exact le_sup_of_le_left inf_le_left;
            have := cancel_modular h ( a ⊓ c ) b ( a ⊔ b ⊓ c ) h_modular;
            grind +qlia;
          · simp +decide;
        rw [ cancel_repr h a b c, cancel_repr h b a c ];
        convert h_sup_inf2 using 1;
        · refine' le_antisymm _ _;
          · exact inf_le_inf ( inf_le_left ) ( inf_le_left );
          · simp +decide [ inf_assoc, inf_left_comm ];
            exact le_trans ( inf_le_right ) ( sup_le_sup_left inf_le_right _ );
        · simp +decide [ sup_assoc, sup_comm ];
          rw [ ← sup_assoc, sup_comm ];
          rw [ ← sup_assoc, sup_comm ];
          rw [ cancel_modular h ];
          · rw [ sup_comm a ];
          · exact inf_le_left
/-
The median identity holds for all triples.
-/
private lemma cancel_median (x y z : α) :
    (x ⊔ y) ⊓ (x ⊔ z) ⊓ (y ⊔ z) = (x ⊓ y) ⊔ (x ⊓ z) ⊔ (y ⊓ z) := by
      -- Let's introduce the three median elements (in the "join" representation):
      set u := (x ⊓ (y ⊔ z)) ⊔ (y ⊓ z)
      set v := (y ⊓ (x ⊔ z)) ⊔ (x ⊓ z)
      set w := (z ⊓ (x ⊔ y)) ⊔ (x ⊓ y);
      -- From `cancel_sup_fact h` and `cancel_inf_fact h`, we have:
      have huv : u ⊔ v = (x ⊔ y) ⊓ (x ⊔ z) ⊓ (y ⊔ z) := by
        convert cancel_sup_fact h x y z using 1
      have hvw : v ⊔ w = (x ⊔ y) ⊓ (x ⊔ z) ⊓ (y ⊔ z) := by
        convert cancel_sup_fact h y z x using 1;
        · grind;
        · ac_rfl
      have huw : u ⊔ w = (x ⊔ y) ⊓ (x ⊔ z) ⊓ (y ⊔ z) := by
        convert cancel_sup_fact h x z y using 1;
        · grind;
        · simp +decide only [inf_comm, sup_comm]
      have huv_inf : u ⊓ v = (x ⊓ y) ⊔ (x ⊓ z) ⊔ (y ⊓ z) := by
        convert cancel_inf_fact h x y z using 1
      have hvw_inf : v ⊓ w = (x ⊓ y) ⊔ (x ⊓ z) ⊔ (y ⊓ z) := by
        convert cancel_inf_fact h y z x using 1;
        · grind +qlia;
        · grind
      have huw_inf : u ⊓ w = (x ⊓ y) ⊔ (x ⊓ z) ⊔ (y ⊓ z) := by
        convert cancel_inf_fact h x z y using 1; all_goals grind;
      grind +splitImp
/-
The distributive inequality, from the median identity via one more cancellation.
-/
private lemma cancel_le_sup_inf (x y z : α) :
    (x ⊔ y) ⊓ (x ⊔ z) ≤ x ⊔ y ⊓ z := by
      revert x y z; (
      -- By the cancellation law and the median identity, we have:
      have h_median : ∀ x y z : α, (x ⊔ y) ⊓ (x ⊔ z) ⊓ (y ⊔ z) = (x ⊓ y) ⊔ (x ⊓ z) ⊔ (y ⊓ z) :=
        cancel_median h
      intro x y z
      set P := (x ⊔ y) ⊓ (x ⊔ z)
      set Q := x ⊔ (y ⊓ z)
      set s := y ⊔ z;
      -- Prove that $s \⊔ P = s \⊔ Q$ and $s \⊔ P = s \⊔ Q$.
      have hsP : s ⊔ P = s ⊔ Q := by
        simp +zetaDelta at *;
        simp +decide [ sup_assoc, sup_left_comm ];
        refine' le_antisymm _ _ <;> simp +decide [ sup_le_iff, le_sup_left ];
        · exact ⟨ le_sup_of_le_right ( le_sup_left ), le_sup_of_le_right ( le_sup_right ), le_trans ( inf_le_left ) ( sup_le_sup_left ( le_sup_left ) _ ) ⟩;
        · exact ⟨ le_sup_of_le_right ( le_sup_of_le_right ( le_inf ( le_sup_left ) ( le_sup_left ) ) ), le_sup_of_le_right ( le_sup_left ) ⟩
      have hsQ : s ⊓ P = s ⊓ Q := by
        have hsP : s ⊓ P = (x ⊓ y) ⊔ (x ⊓ z) ⊔ (y ⊓ z) := by
          rw [ ← h_median, inf_comm ]
        have hsQ : s ⊓ Q = (x ⊓ y) ⊔ (x ⊓ z) ⊔ (y ⊓ z) := by
          refine' le_antisymm _ _;
          · refine' le_trans ( inf_le_inf_left _ ( show Q ≤ P from _ ) ) hsP.le;
            exact sup_le ( le_inf ( le_sup_left ) ( le_sup_left ) ) ( le_inf ( le_sup_of_le_right inf_le_left ) ( le_sup_of_le_right inf_le_right ) );
          · simp +zetaDelta at *
        rw [hsP, hsQ];
      exact h s P Q hsP hsQ ▸ le_rfl)
end OfCancellation
abbrev ofCancellation
    (h : ∀ x y z : α, x ⊔ y = x ⊔ z → x ⊓ y = x ⊓ z → y = z) :
    DistribLattice α where
  le_sup_inf := cancel_le_sup_inf h
end DistribLattice
